findings.reader: A tight, well-bounded daily news item: it reports the September 9 HoneyBook–ChatGPT plugin, grounds it in recognizable small-business tasks, and makes the two-gate mechanism — resource-by-resource permission at connection and draft-until-approved before anything reaches a client — plain enough that a reader can explain it back and apply it to unseen situations. Attribution keeps vendor claims honest, the voice is warm and adult, and no failure family is present.
findings.facts: Every material claim — the September 9 announcement, account-grounded record access, the account requirement, worked examples, the draft-until-approved boundary and the resource-permission/disconnect controls — is directly supported by the HoneyBook announcement and OpenAI directory excerpts with correct attribution. Dates make the story reviewable, and vendor-claim uncertainty survives the writing.
